ciel_bizarre.title: A Strange Sky
ciel_bizarre.text:
You step outside this morning.

The sky is full of colored clouds.

A pink, round one dances gently.
A dark blue one rumbles all by itself.
A yellow one bounces like a child.

Aikito is sitting next to you.
He lifts his nose toward the sky.

**"In this village, feelings rise into the sky."**
**"They turn into clouds."**

You look up above your head.

A tiny orange cloud is floating there.

**"That one is yours."** says Aikito.
**"Curiosity is orange."**

marchand_arrive.title: Mister Gray
marchand_arrive.text:
A cart stops in the square.

**☁️ INDUSTRIAL CLOUDS ☁️**
*Feelings neatly sorted. All the same.*

A man in a gray suit climbs down.

**"Good morning! Your clouds are far too... different."**
**"I'm bringing neatly sorted clouds to the square!"**

He pulls out a big net.

And starts catching the clouds of the village.

The pink one fights back.
The blue one rumbles louder.
The yellow one bounces faster and faster.

**"Stop!"** you shout.

choices.text: Run over and talk to him.

aikito_conseil.title: Aikito's Advice
aikito_conseil.text:
Aikito looks up at you.

**"Dogs show their feelings right out in the open."**
**"We don't need clouds."**

He looks at Mister Gray.

**"But him, he's scared of something."**
**"Look at his cloud."**

Above Mister Gray floats a tiny cloud.
Gray.
All alone.
All sad.

**"Go and talk to him."** says Aikito.

choices.text: Go and talk to Mister Gray.

pourquoi_gris.title: Why?
pourquoi_gris.text:
You stand right in front of Mister Gray.

**"Why are you taking our clouds?"**

He stops.

**"Because they're too different."**
**"It's messy."**
**"People see your feelings, and it bothers them."**

You look at his small gray cloud above him.

**"And yours?"** you ask.

He looks up.

His smile fades for a second.

choices.text: "Your cloud is all gray and all alone."

secret_gris.title: The Secret
secret_gris.text:
Mister Gray looks at his cloud for a long time.

**"It used to be colorful."**

His voice changes.
Softer.

**"But people said my feelings were too strong."**
**"Too visible."**
**"So I turned everything gray."**

He folds his net up slowly.

**"And I thought it would be better for everyone."**

Aikito walks over.
He rests a paw on Mister Gray's foot.

**"That wasn't a good idea."** says Aikito.
**"But it's not too late."**

choices.text: Smile at him without saying anything.

fin_couleurs.title: Ending — The Real Sky
fin_couleurs.text:
Mister Gray closes his eyes.

His little gray cloud starts to change.

First purple.
Then red.
Then bright yellow.

He opens his eyes again.

**"I... I didn't know anymore."**
**"It's been so long."**

The sky above the village is full of colored clouds.

All different.
All real.

Aikito lifts his nose.

**"It's the most beautiful sky I've ever seen."**

And for once,
everyone agrees.

fin_gris_part.title: Ending — The Cloud That Waits
fin_gris_part.text:
Mister Gray leaves with his empty cart.

He stops at the edge of the village.

He looks at the sky one last time.

His little gray cloud floats above him.

But you notice something.

Tiny.
Tucked in a corner.

A red dot.

Like an ember that is waiting.

Aikito looks at you.

**"He might come back."**
**"When he's ready."**

exploration_nuages.title: The Village Clouds
exploration_nuages.text:
You stroll through the village with Aikito.

Above every house, different clouds.

The baker has a warm brown cloud.
*Pride in her morning bread.*

The mail carrier has a light green cloud.
*Joy in walking every day.*

A little girl has a purple cloud that swirls around.
*She dreams of something beautiful.*

You look at yours.
Orange. Curious. A little impatient.

**"Every cloud tells a story."** says Aikito.
**"That's why they're all different."**

choices.text: Ask the little girl what she imagines.

petite_fille_nuage.title: Léa's Dream
petite_fille_nuage.text:
The little girl looks at you.

**"I dream that I'm flying."** she says simply.
**"Every night."**

She points to her purple cloud.

**"It shows up when I think about it."**

She smiles.

**"I love my cloud."**
**"It doesn't look like anyone else's."**

Aikito wags his tail.

**"Exactly."**

That's when you hear a cart arriving in the square.

choices.text: Run over to see what's happening.

village_peur.title: The Village's Fear
village_peur.text:
Mister Gray listens to you.

But the villagers lower their heads.

The baker hides her brown cloud behind her apron.
The mail carrier stares at his feet.

**"Maybe he's right..."** someone whispers.
**"Our clouds are a little... too visible."**

You look at Aikito.

He growls softly.

**"They're ashamed of their feelings."**
**"That's the real problem."**

montrer_nuage.title: My Cloud
montrer_nuage.text:
You raise your arms.

Your orange cloud rises a little higher.

**"Mine is curiosity."**
**"It's not perfect."**
**"But it's me."**

The baker looks at you.

She hesitates.

Then she takes off her apron.

Her warm brown cloud comes back into view.

**"Mine is pride."** she says softly.

One by one, the others do the same.

Mister Gray looks around him.
Then at his small gray cloud.
Then at you.
